summary: New image-conditioned, one continuous all-direction native 1280x720 carrier. Four sequences were selected as forward consecutive complete-flap cycles from stable facing holds; no reversal, ping-pong, duplicated endpoint, mirroring, alpha recentering, or old-atlas upscale was used.

source.source_url_status: Durable uploaded copy of the locally retained new carrier; use only as source recovery/provenance, not as a runtime URL.

canvas.trim_policy: untrimmed fixed 512x512 cells; no alpha-bound/centroid recentering; transparent bounds retained

old_to_new_anchor_mapping.old_anchor_description: Fixed aerial hover-root / virtual ground-contact anchor below suspended talons.

new_source_to_cell.operation: Direct native 1280x720 decode -> chroma alpha matte -> one shared 0.48 scale -> one shared placement in all sequence cells; no per-frame crop/recenter.

world_size_preservation.mapping: Render all new 512px cells at 0.75 of their source-cell scale: the new anchor [256,459] maps exactly to the old world anchor [192,344].

matte.method: chroma distance from #FF00FF after native H.264 decode; alpha ramp 52–96 RGB distance and 0.65px soft edge; RGB set to black where alpha zero

loop_metrics_proxy.selection_note: Metrics computed on 160x90 proxy for bounded selection; all emitted pixels come directly from native 1280x720 frames.

trim.frame_placement: identical shared source transform for every frame
